listing.name: Neutrino Detector On-Screen Display
listing.summary: Adds an on-screen display showing detected entities not currently shown on the map while Neutrino Detector is active.
listing.aiSummary: Adds an on-screen display showing detected entities not currently shown on the map while Neutrino Detector is active.

description:
Description:

While Neutrino Detector is active, an OSD will show up near the hotbar listing detected entities that are not currently shown on the map. Configurable to show faction and distance, can be placed beside or above the hotbar, can be set to only show fleets while Sensor Burst is active.
